name: com.cobourglimo/booking
title: CobourgLimo.com
description: Cobourg and Northumberland County black car and limo service: packages, fares and ride requests.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find CobourgLimo.com pages for an airport (YYZ, YTZ, YPQ, YGK...), city or town (Port Hope, Brighton, Peterborough...), venue, event, hotel, route, package, service or travel topic. Returns titles, summaries and URLs with Markdown versions.

section.description: Optional first path segment filter, e.g. airports, cities, packages, routes, services, events, attractions, hotels, blog

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the Markdown text of a CobourgLimo.com page: pickup points, drive times, fares, tips and FAQ. Accepts a full URL or a path such as /airports/toronto-pearson-yyz/.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: Services, vehicle classes, coverage, what every fixed fare includes, waiting and cancellation rules, contact channels and the booking page link.

tools.name: get_packages
tools.description: Fixed-price round-trip packages from Cobourg (Pearson, Billy Bishop, Toronto, Prince Edward County, Kingston, Niagara Falls and more) by vehicle class, all-in with HST included, and the secure Stripe pay link the traveller can open to pay. Never pay on the traveller's behalf.

tools.name: get_fares
tools.description: All-in planning fare ranges (CAD, HST included) from Victoria Hall, 55 King St W, Cobourg to airports, cities and venues by vehicle class, plus hourly rates. Never quote below the low end. The exact fixed fare is quoted by the reservation engine or the desk.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send a chauffeured ride request to the CobourgLimo.com 24/7 dispatch desk for the traveller. Only call when the traveller explicitly asked to book. Returns a reference (CBL-XXXXXXX); the desk then confirms the fixed fare, vehicle and chauffeur by email or phone. No payment is taken; it is not a confirmed booking until the desk confirms.

package.description: Package slug from get_packages, if booking a round-trip package

pickup.description: Full address, hotel, venue, or airport code + terminal

time.description: Local pickup time HH:MM (for arrivals, the scheduled landing time)

return.description: Return trip date, time and address, if any

notes.description: Child seats, accessibility, meet and greet sign name, stops, etc.

agent.description: Name of your assistant or app

consent.description: The traveller explicitly asked for this booking
